newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chase to launch LAF-eligible HK$2 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Chase to launch LAF-eligible HK$2 bln FRCD.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Bank, acting through its Hong Kong branch, will launch a three-year HK$2.0 billion floating rate certificates of deposit issue on Wednesday, arranger Chase Manhattan Asia said.
It gave no details of the issue.
Application will be made to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) to accept the certificates as eligible for its Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF), or discount window.
Eligibility for LAF makes an issue more attractive to banks because holders of the qualifying debt can engage in repurchase agreements with the HKMA, increasing liquidity.
